Page 1

Campaign performance0

Campaign groups that influenced pipeline or revenue in the period.LinkedIn campaign groups that influenced pipeline or revenue in the period. Pipeline = open influenced deals created in the period; revenue = Closed Won in the period. 10 per page (or Show all). Expand a row for the top 10 companies by revenue, then pipeline. Funnel badges come from the group name.

Page 1

Methodology: campaign group influence, which can double count.Methodology: Zen ABM campaign group influence from August 2026 on; pipeline and revenue can double count across groups (a deal appears under every group that reached the company before create). Spend, impressions and clicks are LinkedIn delivery per group in the period. January to July Fibbler campaign splits appear on the deal campaign breakdown, not in this campaign group section. LinkedIn only. Campaign Manager links use account 506678050.

Things to know

  • Source. YTD is stitched. January to July 2026 comes from the Fibbler dashboard snapshot of Sep 4, 2026 (new business, LinkedIn source). August onward comes from Zen ABM (Salesforce opportunities plus LinkedIn ad account 506678050). The two tools count influence differently, so pre-August months are labeled Fibbler.
  • Snapshot. Fibbler Jan to Jul figures are as of Sep 4, 2026. Later stage changes or closes on those deals are not in the Fibbler file itself. When the same opp is still in Salesforce, the dashboard uses Zen ABM's current stage and amount.
  • Tracking window. YTD runs Jan 1 to Nov 9, 2026. Zen ABM company engagement starts in August 2026, which is why January to July had to be backfilled from Fibbler.
  • Influence. A deal counts when paid LinkedIn activity before the deal reaches the selected threshold: 3+ paid clicks (default), 3+ paid engagements, or 100+ paid impressions. Jan to Jul engagements and impressions come from the Fibbler raw pull behind the Sep 4 dashboard (the published page only listed 3+ click deals, but that pull includes those fields). The toggle applies to the KPIs, cost per opp, pipeline and revenue charts, deal table, campaign breakdown and journeys.
  • Cohort. New business opportunities only (Salesforce opp name contains " - New"). Renewals and expansion are excluded.
  • Create vs close. Pipeline, the deal table and journeys use create date. Revenue uses close date (Closed Won only).
  • Pipeline. Open stages only. Closed lost and disqualified opps count as $0 in influenced pipeline (cards, comparisons, What changed, the monthly pipeline chart and campaign group tables) but still count as influenced deals and in cost per opp, and keep their real amount in the deal table and Deal outcomes. Closed won deals are in revenue, not in the pipeline chart, so the chart bars add up to the pipeline card.
  • Spend. January to July ad spend is Fibbler account LinkedIn spend ($100,814). LinkedIn Ads (account 506678050) and Zen ABM put that same stretch about $2,309 higher, mostly in March, May and June. August onward spend is from Zen ABM. Cost per opp is period spend divided by influenced opportunities created in the period.
  • Comparisons. Last full month compares with the month before. Month to date compares with the same days last month. Last 3 months compares with the prior 3 months (May to July, Fibbler-sourced). YTD has no prior-year comparison.
  • Partial month. November 2026 is partial (Zen ABM data as of Nov 9; 9 of 30 days).
  • Campaign performance. Campaign group performance, funnel-stage mix and delivery by ad type are Zen ABM from August onward. January to July Fibbler campaign splits are on the deal campaign breakdown only, because Fibbler reported campaigns (ad sets), not campaign groups.
  • ABM target list. The ABM target list only box under the title limits every deal-based figure on the page (cards, comparisons, What changed, both charts, campaign group, funnel and campaign performance deals, pipeline and revenue, Deal outcomes, journeys and both deal tables) to companies on the ABM Target List Tim shared on Nov 10, 2026 (732 accounts). Ad spend is account level and not split by company, so ad spend, campaign spend and cost per opp keep total account spend when the box is on. Matching uses the Zen ABM company website against the list’s website and email domain first, then the exact company name with suffixes like Inc, LLC, Ltd and Group removed. Companies with no website or a different name on the list are left out rather than guessed.
  • $225K placeholders. Open Qualified and Discovery deals at exactly $225,000 count as $0 by default in the deal table, overview cards, comparisons, What changed, the pipeline chart and campaign pipeline. Tick Include $225K placeholder amounts in the Influenced deals section to use the real amounts. Deal counts and cost per opp always include these deals. Journeys and the campaign breakdown by deal show the real amount.
  • Journeys. January to July journey coverage is partial. Only companies with a saved Fibbler path are shown.
  • What changed. The summary under the title is generated from the page numbers for the selected influence option and period, using the same comparisons as the cards. Its campaign group lines cover August onward only.
  • Deal outcomes. Depth vs outcome uses influenced deals that closed won, closed lost or were disqualified in the period, by close date, grouped by the activity count behind the selected influence option. Win rate = won / (won + closed lost); a second column also counts disqualified opps.
  • Time to opp. January to July opps use Fibbler’s exact days from first paid impression to create (history from Dec 2024, so many are capped there). August onward opps use the first week with paid impressions in the Zen ABM company timeline, which only starts the week of Aug 3, 2026, so those values are floors. Capped opps are shown separately and never mixed into the measured median.
